page.layout: One column of running text, with a handwritten manuscript mark in the left margin (not printed, so omitted). Running head at the top, page number 116 at the top left, catchword "iam" at the bottom right.

main_text.p: ait,interdum evenire,ut præ judiciū judicio publico fiat: sicut in actione vi bonorum raptorum, & interdicto unde vi. atque hoc quidē exemplum ex libro Ciceronis de arte Rhetorica secundo sumptū est. Huius generis illa Sergij Oratæ, & Marij Gratidiani nobilis controversia est, quā in lib. de Offic. III. & de Orat. I. idem exponit: Marius Gratidianus, inquit, propinquus noster, C. Sergio O-ratæ vendiderat ædes eas, quas ab eodem ipse paucis antè annis emerat. hę ferviebāt (sic enim legendum Aem. Rancōcetus, vir clarissimus,
Note: the catchword "iam" is the first word of the next page and is not repeated in the text.

page.notes: Running head is a heavy printed bar with partly illegible text; I could not read it. The handwritten "Aliud exemplum" in the left margin is manuscript, not print, so it is left out. The quotation marks » at the start of lines are printed in the text. Printed "s" is rendered as "s" throughout. Words split across lines with no printed hyphen (Gratidiani, Sergij, antè, exemplum) are written whole. The "ct" in "actione" is a ligature; I read it as ct with some uncertainty. The bottom marks are stains or show-through and are not transcribed.
